info.title: Enigma API
info.description: The backend of the Navy Enigma simulator and its Bombe, called by the Electron app.

get.summary: Reports that the API is up, with its version.

post.summary: Sets up the machine with a key sheet day, switching model if needed.
Replaces the machine with a default machine of the model.

put.summary: Replaces the machine with one set up with the whole key, all or nothing.
Puts a rotor from the box into a slot; a rotor already there goes back to the box.

delete.summary: Puts the rotor in a slot back in the box.

put.summary: Turns the rotor in a slot to a window letter.
Sets the ring (1–26) of a rotor in the box.
Fits a reflector.

post.summary: Plugs a cable between two letters.

delete.summary: Removes the cable plugged into a letter.

put.summary: Moves one end of a cable to a free socket.

post.summary: Holds a key down: the rotors step and a lamp lights.
Releases the held key.

delete.summary: Clears the record of lit lamps.

get.summary: Gets a key sheet with its daily keys.

delete.summary: Deletes a generated or user-defined key sheet.

post.summary: Generates every month of a year for each network, for one model.
Imports a key sheet file as a user-defined sheet.

get.summary: Exports a key sheet file with its linked books and tables.
Gets a Kenngruppenbuch with its Zuteilungsliste.
Gets a year's set of bigram tables with its calendar.

post.summary: Starts sending a message with the applied daily key.
Finds the key sheet days a radio message can be received with on a date.
Starts receiving a radio message, with a key sheet day or the applied key.

put.summary: Chooses the Schlüsselkenngruppe, Verfahrenkenngruppe and fillers to send with.

post.summary: Finishes the message being sent and gives the radio message.

get.summary: Gets the job: message, crib, menu, settings and machines.

put.summary: Loads pasted text as the message: a radio message or bare cipher text; empty clears it.

post.summary: Loads a historical intercept as the message.
Generates an exercise from a day of the M3 key sheets and loads it.

get.summary: Gets the likely crib of the message, or of a message type.
Lists the message types and their cribs.
Gets the solution of an intercept or exercise.

post.summary: Shows three wheel orders, one of them the key's.
Shows two crib positions of an exercise, one of them the crib's.

put.summary: Sets the crib.
Places the crib at a position and builds the menu; crashes are rejected.
Sets the menu by hand from links of the placed crib.

post.summary: Builds the menu from the placed crib.

get.summary: Measures the menu's stops per wheel order, with and without the diagonal board.

put.summary: Sets the diagonal board and the reflector; left out: unchanged.

post.summary: Plugs up the Bombe with the menu.

put.summary: Cables a scrambler jack to a letter; empty unplugs it.
Fits a drum row of a chain with a rotor, from scrambler 1 up to a scrambler.
Turns a scrambler's drums to start letters, such as ZZB.
Plugs a chain's test register and sets its input wire; left out: unchanged, empty: unplugged or default.
Joins or separates two chains.

post.summary: Starts a run at a speed in positions per second, or at full speed.

put.summary: Changes the speed of the run.

post.summary: Continues a run paused at a stop.

get.summary: Gets the printed stops from an index on; count left out: all.
Gets the stops logged for the notebook from an index on, with their verdicts; count left out: all.

delete.summary: Clears the logged stops and their checks.

put.summary: Sets the checking machine's reflector, drums, rings and windows; left out: unchanged.

post.summary: Presses a key on the checking machine; gives the lamp and, when set up for a stop, its check.
Sets up the checking machine for a stop.

get.summary: Gets the check of a stop, starting it when first asked for.

put.summary: Sets the stecker sheet and the right and middle rings; left out: unchanged.

post.summary: Records the verdict (True, False or Unchecked) and compares it with the solution.
Suggests steckers for the letters not on the sheet, without setting them.
Scores every right ring and sets the best.
Scores every middle ring and sets the best.

get.summary: Gets the 676 left and middle rings with the cores each leads to at the crib.

put.summary: Reads the left and middle rings (1–26) off the ring table; both left out: forgets them.
Writes down a message's Kenngruppen; left out: unchanged, empty: rubbed out; 0 is the broken message.

post.summary: Fills in a message's Kenngruppen from the bigram table.
Takes a pinch of the key sheet day and gives the day's other messages.
